description: Source code for the PDCCH slot resource allocator in a 5G NR scheduler, implementing DFS-based CCE allocation and collision management.

classes.name: pdcch_slot_allocator
classes.description: Class responsible for allocating PDCCH resources using DFS traversal and collision avoidance.

methods.name: alloc_pdcch
methods.description: Attempts to allocate a PDCCH for a given DCI context, retrying with different permutations if necessary.

methods.name: cancel_last_pdcch
methods.description: Cancels the last allocated PDCCH, freeing resources.

methods.name: alloc_dfs_node
methods.description: Creates a DFS tree node for CCE allocation, avoiding collisions.

methods.name: get_next_dfs
methods.description: Traverses DFS tree to find the next feasible CCE allocation configuration.

methods.name: allocate_cce
methods.description: Allocates a CCE position if no collision occurs.
